headline: Don't Whine
caption:
Khamzat Chimaev just told Sean Strickland to stop crying about his injuries 😤
Chimaev or Strickland? 👇

Strickland posted photos of a groin tear and a separated AC joint and said boxing is easier money. Chimaev, who lost the UFC middleweight title to him at UFC 328, fired back in the comments: it happens to all of us, is this your champ? UFC news.

Who's right?
question: Chimaev or Strickland?

v2.story: Strickland showed off his injuries and talked boxing. Chimaev told him to toughen up.
v2.question: Chimaev or Strickland?
